name: squirrelscan
description: Official squirrelscan plugins: website QA for coding agents

plugins.name: squirrelscan
plugins.description: Website QA tool built for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor). 260+ rules across SEO, performance, security, accessibility & agent experience: audit from the CLI, fix findings in code, publish reports, and connect over MCP.

plugins.name: squirrelscan-channel
plugins.description: Opt-in Claude Code channel: pushes squirrelscan cloud audit events into your running session so your agent can pull the report and fix what it finds. Enable with --channels plugin:squirrelscan-channel@squirrelscan.
